scope: One paired synthetic right-button pan plus wheel-zoom run in isolated in-app-browser origin; 24 warmup and 120 measured frames. Not physical-device acceptance or a universal FPS guarantee.

calculatorUiAcceptance.method: Actual mouse clicks on the isolated calculator keypad, capture buttons and Calculate; settled DOM segment states verified.

conclusion: Substantial reduction in timer DOM work, but no median pan/zoom frame-time improvement. Camera rendering remains a separate next milestone. Nested JavaScript times must not be added together.
